main_body: small banded chest: an orange plank block (rows 1-7) over a dark base with a yellow zigzag strip (rows 8-13)
top_band: no single top band. Rows 1-7 alternate between mid and light orange (L 111/141/169/111/202/169/202) like stacked horizontal planks, then row 8 is dark (L 32).
evidence: The scan reads the same in all three columns. Rows 1-3 form only a small gradient. Row 4 drops back to L=111, then rows 5-7 are light again. The 7-row orange block therefore reads as a stack of vertical-face plank bands, like a banded lid or front panel seen face-on, with no distinct front-edge line separating a top from a front. Rows 8-13 are a dark base with a flat painted zigzag, not inset. The orange region fills most of the object and has the same tone family throughout, so it reads as a front elevation with banding. When in doubt, fail.

style.evidence: The candidate has 12 distinct colours and a median of 12 per tile, below the references (17 and 20 per tile, 38-40 distinct). Its dark edge pixels are 100% neutral (#06070e, #20202a), a near-black sticker outline, whereas the references' outlines are tinted (1% and 33% neutral). The orange ramp has about 5 steps and there are no flat 5x5 fills, but the dark grey side strips and the near-black frame look flatter and more sticker-like than the references.
